cards.back:
A large round object that moves around a star.
Bahasa Indonesia: planet
Example: Earth is the planet where we live.
cards.say: planet. A large round object that moves around a star. Earth is the planet where we live.

cards.back:
A huge ball of very hot, glowing gas that gives out light.
Bahasa Indonesia: bintang
Example: The sun is the star closest to Earth.
cards.say: star. A huge ball of very hot, glowing gas that gives out light. The sun is the star closest to Earth.

cards.back:
A huge group of stars, gas and dust.
Bahasa Indonesia: galaksi
Example: Our solar system is part of the Milky Way galaxy.
cards.say: galaxy. A huge group of stars, gas and dust. Our solar system is part of the Milky Way galaxy.

cards.back:
To travel in a curved path around something.
Bahasa Indonesia: mengorbit
Example: The Moon takes about a month to orbit Earth.
cards.say: orbit. To travel in a curved path around something. The Moon takes about a month to orbit Earth.

cards.back:
A natural object that moves around a planet.
Bahasa Indonesia: bulan
Example: We could see the bright moon from our window.
cards.say: moon. A natural object that moves around a planet. We could see the bright moon from our window.

cards.back:
The sun and all the planets that move around it.
Bahasa Indonesia: tata surya
Example: There are eight planets in our solar system.
cards.say: solar system. The sun and all the planets that move around it. There are eight planets in our solar system.

cards.back:
A ball of ice and dust with a long glowing tail.
Bahasa Indonesia: komet
Example: The comet's tail glowed in the dark sky.
cards.say: comet. A ball of ice and dust with a long glowing tail. The comet's tail glowed in the dark sky.

cards.back:
A small rocky object that moves around the sun.
Bahasa Indonesia: asteroid
Example: An asteroid is smaller than a planet.
cards.say: asteroid. A small rocky object that moves around the sun. An asteroid is smaller than a planet.

cards.back:
A tool that makes faraway things look bigger.
Bahasa Indonesia: teleskop
Example: We looked at Saturn through a telescope.
cards.say: telescope. A tool that makes faraway things look bigger. We looked at Saturn through a telescope.

cards.back:
A tall vehicle that carries things into space.
Bahasa Indonesia: roket
Example: The rocket rose into the sky with a loud roar.
cards.say: rocket. A tall vehicle that carries things into space. The rocket rose into the sky with a loud roar.

cards.back:
A person trained to travel and work in space.
Bahasa Indonesia: astronaut
Example: The astronaut waved from the window of the spaceship.
cards.say: astronaut. A person trained to travel and work in space. The astronaut waved from the window of the spaceship.

cards.back:
An object that moves around a planet in space.
Bahasa Indonesia: satelit
Example: A satellite sends television pictures around the world.
cards.say: satellite. An object that moves around a planet in space. A satellite sends television pictures around the world.

cards.back:
The force that pulls things towards Earth.
Bahasa Indonesia: gravitasi
Example: Gravity makes a ball come back down.
cards.say: gravity. The force that pulls things towards Earth. Gravity makes a ball come back down.

cards.back:
Everything that exists, including all of space.
Bahasa Indonesia: alam semesta
Example: Scientists study the whole universe with big telescopes.
cards.say: universe. Everything that exists, including all of space. Scientists study the whole universe with big telescopes.

cards.back:
A bright streak of light made by a space rock burning up in the air.
Bahasa Indonesia: meteor
Example: We saw a meteor flash across the night sky.
cards.say: meteor. A bright streak of light made by a space rock burning up in the air. We saw a meteor flash across the night sky.

cards.back:
A bowl-shaped hole made when something hits a surface.
Bahasa Indonesia: kawah
Example: The Moon has many craters on its surface.
cards.say: crater. A bowl-shaped hole made when something hits a surface. The Moon has many craters on its surface.

cards.back:
When one object in space hides another from view.
Bahasa Indonesia: gerhana
Example: During a solar eclipse, the Moon covers the sun.
cards.say: eclipse. When one object in space hides another from view. During a solar eclipse, the Moon covers the sun.

cards.back:
A vehicle that travels in space.
Bahasa Indonesia: pesawat antariksa
Example: The spacecraft flew far past Mars.
cards.say: spacecraft. A vehicle that travels in space. The spacecraft flew far past Mars.

cards.back:
A large spacecraft where astronauts live and work.
Bahasa Indonesia: stasiun luar angkasa
Example: Astronauts stay on the space station for months.
cards.say: space station. A large spacecraft where astronauts live and work. Astronauts stay on the space station for months.

cards.back:
The red planet, fourth from the sun.
Bahasa Indonesia: Mars
Example: Mars looks red because of the rusty dust.
cards.say: Mars. The red planet, fourth from the sun. Mars looks red because of the rusty dust.

cards.back:
The biggest planet in our solar system.
Bahasa Indonesia: Jupiter
Example: Jupiter is much bigger than Earth.
cards.say: Jupiter. The biggest planet in our solar system. Jupiter is much bigger than Earth.

cards.back:
A planet with bright rings around it.
Bahasa Indonesia: Saturnus
Example: Saturn has beautiful rings made of ice and rock.
cards.say: Saturn. A planet with bright rings around it. Saturn has beautiful rings made of ice and rock.

cards.back:
The layer of gases around a planet.
Bahasa Indonesia: atmosfer
Example: Earth's atmosphere has the air that we breathe.
cards.say: atmosphere. The layer of gases around a planet. Earth's atmosphere has the air that we breathe.

cards.back:
The distance that light travels in one year.
Bahasa Indonesia: tahun cahaya
Example: A star can be many light years away.
cards.say: light year. The distance that light travels in one year. A star can be many light years away.
